On top of that, it keeps a persistent project memory that remembers your decisions, tracks what happened across sessions, and gives the AI full context about your project every time you reconnect. 20→ 21→Built as a standalone package with zero required dependencies. 22→ 23→## Key Features 24→ 25→- **43 MCP Tools** -- Full Houdini control from Claude: nodes, parameters, USD, materials, lighting, rendering, viewport capture 26→- **Persistent Memory** -- Project memory stored alongside your HIP file with search, decisions, and context summaries 27→- **Living Memory** -- Evolving per-project and per-scene markdown journals that grow with your work 28→- **Wire Protocol** -- Typed commands over WebSocket with parameter aliasing and deterministic queuing 29→- **Agentic Execution** -- prepare / propose / execute / learn loop with automatic risk classification 30→- **Human-in-the-Loop Gates** -- Four levels (INFORM, REVIEW, APPROVE, CRITICAL) with batch approval 31→- **VEX Execution** -- Run VEX wrangles directly from conversation 32→- **Production Resilience** -- Rate limiter, circuit breaker, port failover, watchdog, backpressure 33→- **Viewport + Render Capture** -- AI can see what you see via flipbook and Karma renders 34→- **RAG-Powered Routing** -- Knowledge lookup from Houdini documentation (21 built-in workflow recipes) 35→- **Determinism** -- Canonical ordering and tier pinning ([He2025] inspired), plus fixed-precision rounding, content-based IDs, and Kahan summation 36→- **Houdini Optional** -- All 890 tests run without Houdini; core library has zero required dependencies 37→ 38→--- 39→ 40→
